column2: Well thief. I smell you.
column3: Well thief. I smell you.

column2: I hear your breath. I feel your air.
column3: I hear your breath. I feel your air.

column2: Hmm. There is something about you.
column3: Hmm. There is something about you.

column2: Something you carry. Something made of gold.
column3: Something you carry. Something made of gold.

column2: But far more precious.
column3: But far more precious.

column2: There you are Thief in the Shadows.
column3: There you are Thief in the Shadows.

column2: And do you now?!
column3: And do you now?!

column2: Do you think flattery will keep you alive?
column3: Do you think flattery will keep you alive?

column2: You seem familiar with my name but I don't remember smelling your kind before.
column3: You seem familiar with my name but I don't remember smelling your kind before.

column2: Who are you and where do you come from may I ask?
column3: Who are you and where do you come from may I ask?

column2: Impressive. What else do you claim to be?
column3: Impressive. What else do you claim to be?

column2: Lovely titles. Go on.
column3: Lovely titles. Go on.

column2: Barrels? Now that is interesting.
column3: Barrels? Now that is interesting.

column2: Oh, I don't think so, Barrel-rider! They sent you in here to do their dirty work while they skulk about outside.
column3: Oh, I don't think so, Barrel-rider! They sent you in here to do their dirty work while they skulk about outside.

column2: I know the smell and taste of Dwarf.
column3: I know the smell and taste of Dwarf.

column2: No one better! It is the gold! They are drawn to treasure like flies to dead flesh.
column3: No one better! It is the gold! They are drawn to treasure like flies to dead flesh.

column2: Did you think I did not know this day would come?!
column3: Did you think I did not know this day would come?!

column2: That a pack of canting Dwarves would come crawling back to the mountain?!
column3: That a pack of canting Dwarves would come crawling back to the mountain?!

column2: The King Under the Mountain is dead. I took his throne. I ate his people like a wolf among sheep.
column3: The King Under the Mountain is dead. I took his throne. I ate his people like a wolf among sheep.

column2: I kill where I wish, when I wish. My armor is iron.
column3: I kill where I wish, when I wish. My armor is iron.

column2: No blade can pierce me.
column3: No blade can pierce me.

column2: So, Oakenshield that filthy Dwarvish usurper.
column3: So, Oakenshield that filthy Dwarvish usurper.

column2: He sent you in here for the Arkenstone, didn't he?
column3: He sent you in here for the Arkenstone, didn't he?

column2: Don't bother denying it. I guessed his foul purpose some time ago.
column3: Don't bother denying it. I guessed his foul purpose some time ago.

column2: The darkness is coming. It will spread to every corner of the land.
column3: The darkness is coming. It will spread to every corner of the land.

column2: You are being used, Thief in the Shadows. You were only ever a means to an end.
column3: You are being used, Thief in the Shadows. You were only ever a means to an end.

column2: The coward Oakenshield has weighed the value of your life and found it worth nothing.
column3: The coward Oakenshield has weighed the value of your life and found it worth nothing.

column2: What did he promise you? A share of the treasure?
column3: What did he promise you? A share of the treasure?

column2: As if it was his to give. I will not part with a single coin. Not one piece of it.
column3: As if it was his to give. I will not part with a single coin. Not one piece of it.

column2: My claws are spears. My Wings are a hurricane.
column3: My claws are spears. My Wings are a hurricane.

column2: I am almost tempted to let you take it. If only to see Oakenshield suffer.
column3: I am almost tempted to let you take it. If only to see Oakenshield suffer.

column2: Watch it destroy him. Watch it corrupt his heart and drive him mad.
column3: Watch it destroy him. Watch it corrupt his heart and drive him mad.

column2: But I think not. I think our little game ends here. So tell me thief how do you choose to die?
column3: But I think not. I think our little game ends here. So tell me thief how do you choose to die?

column2: You will burn!
column3: You will burn!

column2: Flee. Flee. Run for your lives. There is nowhere to hide.
column3: Flee. Flee. Run for your lives. There is nowhere to hide.

column2: You think you could deceive me, Barrel-rider?
column3: You think you could deceive me, Barrel-rider?

column2: You have come from Lake-town.
column3: You have come from Lake-town.

column2: This is some sordid scheme hatched between these filthy Dwarves and those miserable tub-trading Lakemen.
column3: This is some sordid scheme hatched between these filthy Dwarves and those miserable tub-trading Lakemen.

column2: You care about them do you? Good. Then you can watch them die.
column3: You care about them do you? Good. Then you can watch them die.

column2: You will take nothing from me Dwarf.
column3: You will take nothing from me Dwarf.

column2: I laid low your warriors of old.
column3: I laid low your warriors of old.

column2: I instilled terror in the hearts of Men. I am King Under the Mountain.
column3: I instilled terror in the hearts of Men. I am King Under the Mountain.

column2: Revenge?! I will show you revenge!
column3: Revenge?! I will show you revenge!

column2: Who are you that would stand against me?
column3: Who are you that would stand against me?

column2: Now, that is a pity.
column3: Now, that is a pity.

column2: What will you do now, bowman?
column3: What will you do now, bowman?

column2: You are forsaken. No help will come.
column3: You are forsaken. No help will come.

column2: Is that your child? You cannot save him from the fire.
column3: Is that your child? You cannot save him from the fire.

column2: He will burn.
column3: He will burn.

column2: You have nothing left but your death.
column3: You have nothing left but your death.
